editorialNotes.short: The passionate track captured all the longing of unrequited love.
editorialNotes.standard: Vocalist Arijit Singh comes in close and intimate in the opening phrases of Pritam’s “Ae Dil Hai Mushkil”—but as the song builds in intensity and Amitabh Bhattacharya’s lyrics about the pain of one-sided love are revealed, Singh’s voice builds to a heartbreaking crescendo. Introspective piano, gently insistent rhythms and cascading strings helped make the ballad an indelible testament to the maddening power of love—leading our editors to select it as the Best Song of 2016.
